name: Katrina Kaif
caption: Katrina and Vicky Kaushal introduced son Vihaan to Mumbai paparazzi for the first time at the airport, requesting a no-photo policy. She also reacted to a viral Kay Beauty eyeliner review that took the internet by storm.

name: Diljit Dosanjh
caption: Diljit made history selling out two consecutive nights at Madison Square Garden. His upcoming Imtiaz Ali film releases June 12, and he shared BTS pics from Sardaar Ji 3. Also appearing in the war epic Border 2.

name: Alia Bhatt
caption: Character details for YRF's Alpha revealed — Alia plays a deadly assassin 'raised and built to kill.' The film releases July 10, 2026. Bobby Deol praised her intense action commitment on set.

name: Priyanka Chopra
caption: Priyanka confirmed for Krrish 4 opposite Hrithik Roshan in his directorial debut. She also has 6 months of shoot pending for Rajamouli's Varanasi. Remained on Karan Johar's following list amid his mass unfollow spree.

name: Shah Rukh Khan
caption: SRK's King (action thriller, Dec 24 release) has a ₹350cr budget and ₹250cr distribution deal — starring alongside Suhana Khan, Abhishek Bachchan, and Deepika Padukone. Karan Johar unfollowed SRK on Instagram citing 'digital detox.'

name: Kareena Kapoor Khan
caption: Kareena is in talks to reunite with Salman Khan for Raj & DK's superhero film. She wished Kunal Kemmu and Karan Johar on their birthdays, while Tusshar Kapoor recalled first meeting her back in 1988.

name: Shraddha Kapoor
caption: Shraddha's fun dance video to MJ's 'Bad' went viral — her caption hinted at rumoured beau Rahul Mody. She's in talks for Mahavatar opposite Vicky Kaushal and working on period musical Eetha and Naagin.

name: Deepika Padukone
caption: Deepika announced her second pregnancy with Ranveer Singh. She will use a body double for action in Atlee's Raka (co-starring Allu Arjun) and shot intense action sequences for SRK's King despite the pregnancy.

name: Ranveer Singh
caption: FWICE issued a non-cooperation directive against Ranveer over his Don 3 exit — he was offered ₹10cr upfront plus a ₹25cr discount to settle. His next film Pralay is a ₹300cr zombie thriller currently in production.

name: Aishwarya Rai Bachchan
caption: Aishwarya turned heads at Cannes 2026 (79th edition) with stunning couture looks. A viral video sparked fresh divorce rumours with Abhishek Bachchan. She urged young actors to reject manufactured trends and embrace authenticity.

name: Rashmika Mandanna
caption: Rashmika shined at the 2026 Crunchyroll Anime Awards in Japan as a returning presenter. She married Vijay Deverakonda in February and deleted a leaked Cocktail 2 song. Upcoming: Mysaa, Ranabaali, Cocktail 2.

name: Samantha Ruth Prabhu
caption: Samantha's Maa Inti Bangaaram released May 15 to strong reviews. She married Raj Nidimoru and is focusing on purpose-driven choices in 2026 — also producing films under her banner Tralala Moving Pictures.

name: Allu Arjun
caption: Allu Arjun's mega collaboration with Atlee announced — AA22xA6, a ₹600cr+ sci-fi set in a parallel universe with a dual role. Reports of a Lokesh Kanagaraj collab next. Shoot began June 12 in Mumbai.

name: Ram Charan
caption: Ram Charan's Peddi (sports action drama) releases June 4, 2026 — trailer crossed 100M views in 24 hours. ₹350cr budget with AR Rahman music. PM Modi personally asked about the film. Chiranjeevi intervened for the Telangana release.

name: Jr NTR
caption: Jr NTR's Dragon (with Prashanth Neel) glimpse clocked 64M+ YouTube views in 24 hours — the film is set in 1967's Golden Triangle. He paid tribute to grandfather NTR on his 103rd birth anniversary. War 2 with Hrithik is getting ₹100cr Telugu offers.

name: Janhvi Kapoor
caption: Janhvi is promoting Peddi with Ram Charan, joking about his boundless energy. Her film Homebound was India's Oscar entry this year. She joined Pat Cummins for a New Balance event and also stars in Allu Arjun's AA22xA6.

name: Ananya Panday
caption: Ananya's Chand Mera Dil (with Lakshya) crossed ₹19cr in its first week after releasing May 22. She exited Choomantar due to a scheduling conflict with Call Me Bae Season 2.

name: Kiara Advani
caption: Kiara reveals how Yash's Toxic redefines male-female dynamics — she plays Nadia, shot in Kannada and English. Set to headline a Madhubala biopic with Bhansali producing. She also discussed motherhood plans on a podcast.

name: Hrithik Roshan
caption: War 2 (with Jr NTR) teaser launched to massive buzz — ₹100cr Telugu distribution offers pouring in. Hrithik is making his directorial debut with Krrish 4 and denied Don 3 replacement rumors. Krrish 4 delayed over a VFX disagreement with YRF.

name: Varun Dhawan
caption: Varun's Hai Jawani Toh Ishq Hona Hai releases June 5, 2026 — David Dhawan's final directorial. Vashu Bhagnani filed a ₹400cr lawsuit against the production. Varun is actively promoting with Mrunal Thakur and Pooja Hegde.

name: Shreya Ghoshal
caption: Shreya purchased a luxury Worli home for ₹29.7cr and dropped a live album from her All Hearts Tour. She revealed she once refused to sing 'Fevicol Se.' US tour dates set for Sept 2026. Also collaborated on Ram Charan's Peddi soundtrack.

name: AR Rahman
caption: AR Rahman composed the music for Ram Charan's Peddi and attended a Bhopal musical event. He's co-producing Shekhar Kapur's Masoom sequel and took a 40-day digital detox to compose for the Ramayana film.

name: Vijay Thalapathy
caption: Vijay won the Tamil Nadu elections and is set to become Chief Minister. His final film Jana Nayagan (swansong) is awaiting CBFC certificate, targeting a June 19 release. Son Jason Sanjay's directorial debut Sigma confirmed for July 31.
